Two Audiences, One Website

Buyers want fast, filterable property search with good photography. Sellers want evidence you can market a home and get a price for it.

We design for both without letting either take over, because a site that only serves buyers quietly costs you the listings that make the business work.

  • Listing feed integration, kept in sync
  • Valuation requests and seller landing pages
  • Agent profiles that generate direct enquiries

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you integrate our listing feed?

Yes. We sync from the major listing systems so your site updates automatically as stock changes.

Can buyers save searches and get alerts?

Yes, and it is one of the most effective features for bringing buyers back to your site rather than a portal.

How do we get more valuation requests?

Dedicated seller pages, local sales evidence and a low-friction valuation form. We design that route deliberately.

How long does it take?

Usually eight to twelve weeks, with feed integration accounting for much of the schedule.
